hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *"rm -rf"* ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *"push --force"* ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *"sudo"* ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command" >&2; exit 2; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" =~ \\.py$ ]]; then (command -v black >/dev/null 2>&1 && black "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS") || true; python -m py_compile "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
